$Comment: Raise a boss wave now: the boss rides out of a manual spawn marker standing in the arena's prefab,
the game's own boss bar points at him, and the library hears a wave went out. It is
Zc_Encounter_Endless's BossWave unless a run names another, so a dungeon that stamps a ManualTrigger
marker near its run's entity has a boss wave with nothing written; name the marker and the bar's words
through the Variant's _ForwardedModifiers:
"_ForwardedModifiers": { "BossWave": { "SpawnMarker": "My_Boss_Marker",
"BarName": "npcs.My_Boss.name", "Moment": "My_Boss_Rides" } }
In order, all in the one tick the wave rises. The spawn marker standing within SummonRange of the
script's entity fires, and the creature it raises is bound into Slot: the one named SpawnMarker, or,
left empty, any manual marker in range. A marker fires only once the creature it raised last has died,
which by a boss wave he always has, since no wave is beaten while one of the run's creatures lives.
Then, with him bound, the bar points at him under BarName (left empty, his own name as the server
spells it), shown to every player in the run; it follows him and goes away once his body does. Then
Signal goes out (zc:wave, as every wave of the run sends), and when Moment names a FeedbackMoment each
member is shown it, carrying the run's wave count as wave.
Slot is never Boss on purpose: the library reads a fight's Boss slot as the subject it credits, scales
and pays for, and an endless run has none. Bound anywhere else he is one of the run's creatures, so each
return takes the dungeon's per-return ramp and the binding row's Scale.Adds grows him with the party.
Groups in Zc_Encounter_Endless must hold him, or his wave is beaten the moment it rises. Since he comes
from a spawn marker rather than the Spawn action, a mod that scales spawned creatures leaves him alone.
For a boss raised on the spot instead, hand the slot Zc_Wave_Rise with the boss as Role.

SpawnMarker.Description: The manual spawn marker in the arena's prefab that raises the boss. Empty fires any manual marker within SummonRange.

SummonRange.Description: How far from the script's entity the spawn marker may stand to be fired.

Slot.Description: The target slot the boss is bound into. Never Boss, which the library reads as the fight's subject.

BarName.Description: The lang key the boss bar shows, resolved on each player's own client. Empty shows the boss's own name, untranslated.

BarRange.Description: How far from the script's entity the bound boss may stand to be given the bar.

Signal.Description: The beat sent as the wave rises: zc:wave, or zc:wave:<label>.

Moment.Description: The FeedbackMoment each member is shown as he rises, carrying the run's wave count as wave. Empty shows nothing.

Instructions.$Comment: He rides out of his marker, bound into Slot: the named marker, or any manual marker in range.
With him bound, the bar points at him.
The wave's beat, then the banner, after the signal so the wave count it carries counts this wave.
